name: muki-ai-plugins
description: Muki's Claude Code plugins — project lore knowledge base, test quality review, visual regression testing, and Jev-powered web search.

plugins.name: figma-visual-reviewer
plugins.description: Visual regression testing — compare Figma designs against live web pages with pixel-level diff and AI vision.

plugins.name: review-tests
plugins.description: Test review doctor — diagnose an existing test file for blind spots and output a self-contained HTML report. Read-only; never modifies code.

plugins.name: lore
plugins.description: Capture, consult, guard, scaffold, maintain, health-check, and language-align project lore — the implicit knowledge (business rules, API maps, pitfalls, decision rationale) that code, types, and git history can't reveal.

plugins.name: jev-search
plugins.description: Web search through Jev Search: answers Claude Code's built-in WebSearch with Jev-ranked results (sources and time window chosen by Jev) and falls back to the built-in tool when Jev cannot answer. Adds the jev_search MCP tool and a skill. Requires CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.
